attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) to route between lan-a (node2, 10.50.10.0/24 via eth1) and lan-b (node3, 10.50.20.0/24 via eth2) using an Ansible playbook run from the control node (node4). No NAT is used, so node2 and node3 reach each other on any port with original source addresses preserved. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity change confirmed and post-restart health/connectivity verified for each.
